title: Equitable funding for inclusive big team science
title_zh: 公平资助与包容性大团队科学
abstract: Big team science seeks to make research more inclusive, but the cost of recruiting representative samples can vary markedly across countries. This risks reinforcing the very inequalities these collaborations seek to address. Pooling resources and asking funders to contribute according to their financial capacity could help to overcome these inequalities.
abstract_zh: 大团队科学旨在使研究更加包容，但招募具有代表性样本的成本在不同国家可能差异显著。这可能会加剧这些合作试图解决的不平等现象。共享资源并要求资助方根据其财务能力进行资助，可能有助于克服这些不平等。
